title: Tuning the upload moderation classifier
prompt: A content classifier scores every user upload before it reaches other users. You must decide how to act on its scores. How should you configure the moderation pipeline?
constraint: Minimize harmful content reaching users while not over-blocking legitimate uploads — both failure modes are costly.

options.why: Maximizing recall catches more harmful content but floods the block list with false positives, over-blocking legitimate uploads — the constraint explicitly penalizes that, so this only satisfies half the goal.

High precision avoids over-blocking, but a precision-tuned threshold lets borderline harmful content slip through to users — directly violating the 'minimize harmful content reaching users' half of the constraint.

The constraint penalizes both failure modes, and the uncertain band is exactly where precision-vs-recall forces a bad either/or. Routing only that band to humans catches harmful content without over-blocking legitimate uploads, while keeping review volume bounded — best fit.

Appeals recover some wrongly-blocked uploads, so it partially addresses over-blocking — but legitimate content is still blocked by default and only restored if users notice and complain, making it weaker than reviewing the uncertain band proactively.
